source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Organize the records by site.
3. Match the dates on the records to the dates of the tests.
4. Add “N” for “negative” or “P” for “positive” to the inspection record.
5. Match the initial and follow-up to the test record or enter dates.
6. Multiply the number of tests times the daily flow taken from the last year’s annual report.
7. Divide this number by site by the population.
8. Multiply this number by 1000 to give CAL or CFUs/1000 gallons.
9. Write the result under “Final Result.”
10. State the “Percent of Population Served” for each Sample Set.
11. Give the reason for the test failure under “Reason for Test Failure.”
12. Use the Summary Tab to Verify the Data to be Sure all Failures are Reported.
